Mohamed Attauabi is a medical professional who serves on the steering committee for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. He represents the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) in his capacity as a resident physician (reservelæge) [^src1]. His presence on the committee is notable because it marks the inclusion of younger and future medical professionals in the strategic leadership of the national quality register for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [^src1]. 

As part of the steering committee, Attauabi contributes to the strategic management of DANIBD, which operates within a broader national effort to systematize and improve IBD treatment in Denmark [^src1]. This initiative relies on cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evidence-based development of treatment guidelines to evaluate treatment access, conduct clinical benchmarking, and implement quality indicators [^src1].
